subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext` permanently expose a public after-compaction reset API, and if so should the contract be only `resetSession(reason?)` or also preserve the unshipped explicit-key overload?
rationale: This creates compatibility-sensitive plugin authority over session lifecycle; repository policy cannot determine whether maintainers want that permanent public contract or compatibility with the closed, unmerged predecessor proposal.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Expose only current-session `resetSession(reason?)`, remove the unshipped explicit-key overload and unrelated tool-loop behavior, then require contract docs and live lifecycle proof.

options.title: Sponsor the broader compatibility shape
options.body: Explicitly approve both signatures as permanent plugin API and require focused compatibility, security-boundary, and upgrade tests before merge.

options.title: Decline the core API
options.body: Keep session rotation owner-controlled and move Remnic-specific post-compaction reset policy outside this core hook contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Expose only current-session `resetSession(reason?)`, remove the unshipped explicit-key overload and unrelated tool-loop behavior, then require contract docs and live lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice governs central session lifecycle authority and the permanent public plugin contract across bundled runtimes.
